judge.reason: The answer computes 40 × 0.75 = 30 h, explicitly rejects the 6× multiplier, and treats maintainer spec, review and integration time as the binding constraint. It names the maintainer as sole accountable owner, flags the bus-factor-of-one risk without inventing a team, and frames the worker caps (2–3), review split and review-cost ratios as placeholders to measure and revise. Two minor weaknesses: its reconstruction of the planner's error (×0.75 ≈ 22, rounded to 20) is speculative, and AI-worker permissions are covered only through decision rights.
